facts.fact: FaydaVerse says its identity authentication service, using one-time passwords, has processed about 200 million authentication operations and about two million verification requests a day, charged to banks and other institutions since August 2026.
FaydaVerse says its verification service is open to government institutions, private companies and start-ups, with banks named as users.

note: Digital credentials, citizen wallets and digital signing are only planned.
